blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Vision-Language models (VLMs) are increasingly being explored in autonomous driving for tasks such as scene understanding, driving reasoning, decision-making, and end-to-end driving. As their role becomes more prominent, ensuring their robustness and reliability is increasingly important. In real-world conditions, visual inputs may be degraded by sensor imperfections and environmental conditions, potentially affecting both model predictions and their associated confidence. Such degradation is especially concerning in autonomous driving, where safety-critical decisions require models to make accurate predictions and recognize when their predictions may be unreliable. In this work, we evaluate five VLMs (Qwen3.5-9B, Gemma4-E4B, LLaVA-OneVision-7B, DriveFusion/DriveFusionQA-4B, and NVIDIA Alpamayo-1.5-10B) across four driving-related QA datasets with different visual input settings, including single-frame, multi-view, multi-frame, and monocular inputs. Our results show that the effects of visual corruption vary across models, datasets, and input settings, with changes in accuracy and confidence reliability and also differing across conditions. We then apply Visual Evidence Augmentation ( V ​ EA \mathrm{V}{\scriptstyle\mathrm{EA}} ), a recent inference-time method to examine whether it can improve model reliability under degraded visual conditions. We find that V ​ EA \mathrm{V}{\scriptstyle\mathrm{EA}} improves performance for some models and datasets, although the gains are not consistent across all settings.
blocks.zh: 在自主驾驶现场理解,驾驶推理,决策,端对端驾驶等任务时,视野-语言模型(VLMs)日益被探索. 随着它们的作用日益突出,确保它们的稳健性和可靠性日益重要。 在现实世界条件下,视觉输入可能会因传感器的不完善和环境条件而退化,从而可能影响模型预测及其相关的信心。 这种退化尤其涉及自主驾驶,因为安全关键的决定需要模型作出准确的预测,并在预测可能不可靠时予以确认。 在这项工作中,我们评价了5个VLM(Quen3.5-9B,Gemma4-E4B,LLaVA-One Visions-7B,DriveFusion/DriveFusionQA-4B,NVIDIA Alpamayo-1.5-10B)在四个驱动相关的QA数据集中,具有不同的视觉输入设置,包括单帧,多视图,多帧和单元输入. 我们的结果表明,视觉腐败的影响因模型、数据集和输入设置而异,其准确性和可靠性也发生了变化,而且情况也不同。 然后我们采用视觉证据增强法(V EA\mathrm{V\scriptystyle\mathrm{EA}),这是一种最近的推论-时间方法,以检查它是否能够在退化的视觉条件下提高模型可靠性. 我们发现, V EA\ mathrm{V\scriptysty\ mathrm{EA} 改善了一些模型和数据集的性能,尽管所有设置的增益并不一致.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Autonomous driving is an emerging area in intelligent transportation systems that offers safer mobility, improved traffic efficiency, and new forms of urban transport [ 1 ] . Traditionally, a modular pipeline architecture is followed, in which perception, prediction, planning, and control are separated into distinct subsystems [ 2 , 3 , 4 ] . However, these modular systems are prone to error accumulation between interfaces and struggle to achieve global optimization in highly interactive traffic environments [ 5 ] . In response, end-to-end autonomous driving (E2E-AD) has attracted attention, in which multimodal sensory inputs are directly mapped to driving actions via unified differentiable models [ 6 , 7 , 8 , 9 ] . It reduces system coupling and allows combined optimization of perception, decision-making, and control [ 10 ] . Despite the progress, the current E2E approaches still have gaps in handling long-tail and safety-critical situations, where there is a need for sparse supervision and the need high-level reasoning [ 11 ] .
blocks.zh: 自主驾驶是智能交通系统中一个新兴领域,可提供更安全的交通,提高交通效率,以及新型城市交通[1]. 传统上遵循模块化管道架构,其中感知,预测,规划和控制被分离成不同的子系统[2,3,4]. 然而,这些模块化系统在界面之间容易发生错误积累,在高度互动的交通环境中为实现全球优化而挣扎 [5]. 作为回应,端对端自主驾驶(E2E-AD)引起了人们的注意,其中多模式感知输入直接被映射到通过统一的不同型号驱动动作[6,7,8,9]. 它可以减少系统耦合,并允许综合优化感知,决策,和控制[10]. 尽管取得了这些进展,但目前的E2E办法在处理长期和安全危急情况方面仍有差距,因为在这方面需要很少的监督,需要高层次的推理[11]。

blocks.en: With visual and language understanding, VLMs offer a promising direction for many parts of E2E-AD [ 12 , 13 , 14 , 15 , 16 , 17 ] . They can help with tasks like perception, scene understanding, and context-aware decision-making. However, their reliability in real-world driving is still unclear. Unlike benchmark datasets, real-world driving contains many rare and difficult cases that may not be well represented in large-scale training data. For instance, in real world driving, camera inputs are rarely ideal and are affected by environmental and sensor-related challenges such as illumination changes, adverse weather etc. These perturbations/corruptions can affect not only prediction accuracy but also model confidence and calibration, which are important in safety-critical settings. As an example, Figure 1 shows how Gemma4-E4B’s response change when the input is perturbed compared with the clean input.
blocks.zh: 以视觉和语言理解,VLM为E2E-AD的许多部分[12,13,14,15,16,17]提供了有希望的方向. 它们可以帮助完成感知、场景理解和了解背景的决策等任务。 然而,它们在现实世界中驾驶的可靠性仍然不明确。 与基准数据集不同,现实世界驱动包含许多罕见和困难的案例,在大规模培训数据中可能没有很好的体现. 例如,在现实世界的驾驶中,相机输入很少是理想的,受到诸如照明变化、恶劣天气等环境和传感器相关挑战的影响。 这些扰动/腐败不仅会影响预测的准确性,而且会影响模型的置信度和校准度,这对于安全关键环境很重要。 例如,图1显示了Gemma4-E4B在输入与清洁输入相比被扰动时的反应如何变化.

blocks.en: Figure 1: Gemma4-E4B responses to clean and perturbed inputs.
blocks.zh: 图1:Gemma4-E4B对清洁和扰动投入的反应。

blocks.en: To examine the camera perturbation effects in autonomous driving, we evaluate recent vision-language models with 10B parameters or fewer (considering the importance of inference latency and computational cost for deployment). Our evaluation includes Gemma4-4B [ 18 ] , LLaVA-OV-8B [ 19 ] , Qwen3.5-9B [ 20 ] , DriveFusionQA-4B [ 21 ] , and NVIDIA Alpamayo-1.5-10B [ 22 ] . DriveFusionQA-4B is a driving-specific VLM, while Alpamayo-1.5 is a driving-specific vision-language-action model with visual question-answering capabilities and is included because of its production-oriented design. We evaluate these models on four autonomous driving VQA benchmarks, namely DrivingVQA [ 23 ] , STRIDE-QA Bench [ 24 ] , NuScenes-QA-mini [ 25 , 26 , 4 ] , and Open Spatial Reasoning [ 27 ] . These benchmarks differ in both the reasoning tasks they cover and the way visual information is presented, including single images, consecutive frames, and multi-view camera inputs. This diversity allows us to examine whether the effect of visual corruption is consistent across different driving tasks and input settings, rather than being specific to one benchmark or one data format.
blocks.zh: 为了审查相机在自主驾驶中的扰动效应,我们评价了最近带有或少于10B参数的视觉语言模型(考虑到推论延迟和部署计算成本的重要性). 我们的评价包括Gemma4-4B[18],LLaVA-OV-8B[19],Quen3.5-9B[20],DriveFusionQA-4B[21],以及NVIDIA Alpamayo-1.5-10B[22]。 DriveFusionQA-4B是一种驱动特异性的VLM,而Alpamayo-1.5则是具有视觉问答能力的驱动特异性视觉语言动作模型,因其面向生产的设计而被列入其中. 我们以四个自主驱动的VQA基准来评价这些模型,即驱动VQA [23],STRIDE-QA座椅 [24],NuScens-QA-mini [25,26,4],以及开放空间理由 [27]. 这些基准在它们涵盖的推理任务和视觉信息的呈现方式上各不相同,包括单一图像,连续帧,以及多视图相机输入. 这种多样性使我们能够审查视觉腐败的影响在不同的驱动任务和输入环境之间是否一致,而不是针对一个基准或一个数据格式。

blocks.en: To capture different sources of visual degradation, we consider four common camera perturbations, namely glare, fog, motion blur, and lens occlusion. Each one represents a broader category of real-world visual degradation. Glare represents illumination changes, fog represents adverse weather, motion blur represents sensor and motion-related effects, and lens occlusion represents partial visibility. This provides coverage of different corruption types while keeping the evaluation focused and controlled. We further investigate if V ​ EA \mathrm{V}{\scriptstyle\mathrm{EA}} [ 28 ] , an inference-time attention-based visual enhancement method can transfer to autonomous driving and improve model performance under corrupted inputs. This leads to the following research questions.
blocks.zh: 为了捕捉视觉退化的不同来源,我们考虑四种常见的相机扰动,即光线,雾,运动模糊,以及镜头闭塞. 每一个都代表了更广泛的现实世界视觉退化类别。 Glare代表照明变化,雾代表不利天气,运动模糊代表传感器和运动相关效应,镜头隐蔽代表部分可见度. 这涵盖不同的腐败类型,同时保持评价的重点和控制。 我们进一步调查V EA\mathrm{V\scripttyle\mathrm{EA}[28],一种基于推论的基于注意力的视觉增强方法可以转移到自主驱动,在腐败输入下改进模型性能. 这导致以下研究问题.

blocks.en: (1) How do real-world visual corruptions affect the accuracy and calibration of vision-language models across different autonomous driving tasks and visual input settings?
blocks.zh: (1)真实世界视觉腐败如何影响不同自主驱动任务和视觉输入设置的视觉语言模型的准确性和校准性?

blocks.en: (2) To what extent can inference-time visual enhancement improve model robustness under real-world visual perturbations?
blocks.zh: (2)在现实世界视觉扰动下,推断时间视觉增强能在多大程度上改善模型稳健性?

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: The corruptions in visual inputs presents a significant challenge to the reliability of VLM-based autonomous driving systems. DriveBench [ 29 ] was one of the first benchmarks specifically designed examining this problem, assessing VLMs under 15 different types of corruption across perception, prediction, planning, and behaviour tasks and showing that these systems have a considerable dependence on language priors when the visual input is degraded. But there has been less investigation into robustness in more diverse spatial, temporal, and complex reasoning tasks. USB [ 30 ] takes this approach further by applying it to unstructured driving situations with 20 different perturbations involving illumination, weather, occlusion, and sensor reliability, while at the same time evaluating both decision accuracy and reasoning quality. Other recent work has focused on naturally occurring adverse conditions: AWDB [ 31 ] looks at video-based scene understanding in winter driving situations, while ObsDriveBench [ 32 ] assesses multimodal reasoning using camera, LiDAR, and radar in real-world conditions such as fog, rain, snow, and low light. Yet despite this advancement, current robustness benchmarks generally focus on performance degradation, while uncertainty estimation and calibration remain largely underexplored.
blocks.zh: 视觉投入中的腐败对基于VLM的自主驱动系统的可靠性构成重大挑战。 Drive Bench[29]是专门研究这一问题的首批基准之一,它评估了15种不同类型腐败下的VLM,包括认知、预测、规划和行为任务,并表明这些系统在视觉输入退化时相当依赖语言前传。 但是,在更为多样化的空间、时间和复杂推理任务中,对稳健性的调查较少。 USB [30] 进一步采用这种方法,将这种方法应用于有20种不同扰动的无结构驾驶情况,涉及照明、天气、隐蔽和传感器可靠性,同时评估决定的准确性和推理质量。 其他近期的作品主要关注自然发生的不利条件:AWDB[31]在冬季驾驶情况下看视频的场景理解,而ObsDrive Bench[32]则在雾,雨,雪,低光等现实世界条件下使用相机,LiDAR和雷达来评估多模式推理. 然而,尽管取得了这一进展,目前的稳健性基准一般侧重于业绩退化,而不确定性估计和校准仍然在很大程度上没有得到充分利用。

blocks.en: Several approaches have been proposed to improve how VLMs use visual information at inference time. Some methods modify the decoding process to improve visual grounding and reduce the influence of language priors, such as VCD [ 33 ] and OPERA [ 34 ] . Other methods improve visual evidence utilization through prompting or intermediate reasoning. For example, CGR [ 35 ] first extracts detailed visual information and then uses this intermediate representation to generate the final answer. A growing line of work instead refines the visual input using signals from the model itself. VAR [ 35 ] uses attention scores from the final layer to create a binary mask that highlights salient image regions, while AGLA [ 36 ] uses GradCAM-based signals to mask irrelevant regions and combines predictions from the original and masked images. V ​ EA \mathrm{V}{\scriptstyle\mathrm{EA}} [ 28 ] follows training-free direction by using attention-based visual enhancement to improve the use of relevant image evidence during inference. Other approaches operate on internal representations, such as VTI [ 37 ] and Activation Steering Decoding [ 38 ] , while fine-tuning methods such as HA-DPO [ 39 ] improve visual grounding through additional training.
blocks.zh: 已提出若干办法,以改进脆弱LMs在推断时如何使用视觉信息。 一些方法修改解码过程,以改善视觉地基,减少语言前缀的影响,如VCD[33]和OPERA[34]. 其他方法通过提示性或中间推理改进视觉证据的利用. 例如,CGR[35]首先提取详细的视觉信息,然后使用这种中间表示生成最终答案. 越来越多的工作线反而利用模型本身的信号来完善视觉输入. VAR [35] 使用来自最终层的注意分数来创建突出突出突出图像区域的二进制面具,而AGLA [36] 则使用基于GradCAM的信号来掩盖不相关的区域,并结合了原始图像和蒙面图像的预测. V EA\mathrm{V\scripttyle\mathrm{EA}[28] 通过使用基于注意力的视觉增强来改进相关图像证据在推论期间的使用,遵循无训练方向. 其他方法在内部表现上运作,如VTI[37]和激活引导解码[38],而HA-DPO[39]等微调方法则通过额外培训改善视觉定位.

blocks.en: 3 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 3 实验设置

blocks.en: In this section, we describe the datasets and models, evaluation metrics, and visual corruptions used in our experiments.
blocks.zh: 在本节中,我们描述了我们实验中使用的数据集和模型,评价度量衡,以及视觉腐败.

blocks.en: 3.1 Datasets and Models
blocks.zh: 3.1 数据集和模型

blocks.en: Datasets
blocks.zh: 数据集

blocks.en: We evaluate the models on four driving VQA datasets, DrivingVQA [ 23 ] , NuScenes-QA-mini derived from NuScenes-QA [ 25 ] , STRIDE-QA Bench [ 24 ] , and Open Spatial Reasoning (OSR) [ 27 ] . DrivingVQA contains 3,931 multiple-choice questions derived from challenging real-world scenarios in French driving theory tests, with two to four answer options per question. NuScenes-QA is a multi-camera driving VQA dataset collected in Boston and Singapore, with questions covering existence, counting, object identification, object status, and comparison. We use NuScenes-QA-mini and formulate QA as open-ended text generation, rather than classification over the predefined answer set used in the original NuScenes-QA evaluation. STRIDE-QA Bench focuses on numerical and spatial reasoning in driving scenes, including distance and count estimation. OSR is a challenging monocular 3D spatial-reasoning benchmark containing 50 multiple-choice questions. Although small, we include OSR as a targeted diagnostic benchmark because it directly probes monocular 3D spatial reasoning that is less explicitly evaluated by the larger datasets. For evaluation, we use 1,000 samples from DrivingVQA and STRIDE-QA Bench, 1,117 samples from NuScenes-QA-mini, and all 50 OSR examples.
blocks.zh: 我们评价四个驱动VQA数据集、驱动VQA [23]、NuScenes-QA-mini衍生自NuScenes-QA [25]、STRIDE-QA座椅[24]和开放空间理由(OSR)[27]的模型。 DriverVQA包含3,931个多选题,来自于法国驾驶理论测试中挑战现实世界的情景,每个问题有2到4个答案选项. NuScens-QA是一款在波士顿和新加坡收集的多相机驱动VQA数据集,其问题涵盖存在,计数,对象识别,对象状态,以及比较. 我们使用 NuScenes-QA-mini 来制定 QA 作为开放式的文本生成, 而不是对 NuScenes-QA 评价中使用的预定义的答案集进行分类 。 STRIDE-QA座椅侧重于驱动场景中的数值和空间推理,包括距离和计数估计. OSR是一个具有挑战性的单元3D空间推理基准,包含50个多重选择问题. 虽然规模较小,但我们把OSR作为一个有针对性的诊断基准,因为它直接探寻大数据集不太明确评价的单光三维空间推理. 为了评估,我们使用来自DriverVQA和STRIDE-QA座椅的1 000个样本,来自NuScens-QA-mini的1 117个样本,以及所有50个OSR实例。

blocks.en: Models
blocks.zh: 模型

blocks.en: We evaluate five models including general-purpose and driving-specific vision-language architectures. The general-purpose models include Qwen3.5-9B , Gemma4-E4B , and LLaVA-OneVision-7B , while DriveFusionQA-4B is specifically fine-tuned for visual question answering and reasoning in autonomous-driving scenarios. We additionally evaluate NVIDIA Alpamayo-1.5-10B , a driving-specific vision-language-action model designed for autonomous driving. Although primarily developed for reasoning and trajectory prediction, Alpamayo-1.5 also explicitly supports visual question answering through its generate_text interface, allowing it to be evaluated under the same question-answering setting. Its inclusion examine whether the observed robustness and intervention effects extend beyond conventional VLMs to models explicitly optimized for autonomous-driving reasoning.
blocks.zh: 我们评价五个模式,包括通用和驱动特定视觉语言架构。 通用型号包括Quen3.5-9B,Gemma4-E4B,以及LLaVA-One Visiion-7B,而DriveFusionQA-4B则在自主驾驶情景中为视觉问题解答和推理专门进行了微调. 此外,我们还对NVIDIA Alpamayo-1.5-10B进行了评估,这是一个专门为自主驾驶设计的驱动专用视觉语言行动模型。 虽然主要是为了推理和轨迹预测而开发的,但阿尔帕马约-1.5也明确支持通过它的生成_文本接口进行视觉问题回答,允许在相同的问答环境下对其进行评价. 它的列入审查所观察到的稳健性和干预效应是否超越了常规的VLM,扩大到明确优化的模型,用于自主驾驶推理.

blocks.en: 3.2 Evaluation Protocol and Metrics
blocks.zh: 3.2 评价规程和计量

blocks.en: Dataset-specific evaluation
blocks.zh: 特定数据集评价

blocks.en: The evaluation protocol follows the answer format of each benchmark. DrivingVQA and Open Spatial Reasoning (OSR) use multiple-choice questions and are evaluated using exact-match accuracy. For NuScenes-QA-mini , which contains open-ended answers, we additionally use GPT-4 judge to account for semantically correct responses that may differ from the reference answer in wording. For STRIDE-QA Bench, we follow the benchmark’s original localization criterion. A prediction is considered correct when the distance error is within ± 25 % \pm 25\% of the ground-truth value and the heading error is within ± 10 ∘ \pm 10^{\circ} [ 24 ] .
blocks.zh: 评价协议遵循每个基准的答案格式。 驱动VQA和开放空间理性(OSR)使用多个选择问题,并使用精确匹配的精度进行评估. NuScenes-QA-mini 载有无限制的答案,我们额外使用GPT-4判断来解释措辞上可能不同于参考答案的精密正确反应. 对于STRIDE-QA法官,我们遵循基准的最初本地化标准。 当距离误差在地面真实值的±25%\pm 25%以内,而标题误差在±10\pm 10\circ}[24]以内时,预言被认为是正确的.

blocks.en: Metrics
blocks.zh: 计量

blocks.en: We evaluate model performance using Accuracy , AUROC , Expected Calibration Error (ECE) and the Brier score . Accuracy measures task performance, while AUROC evaluates how well uncertainty distinguishes correct from incorrect predictions. For AUROC, we use VAUQ (Vision-Aware Uncertainty Quantification) [ 40 ] , a training-free uncertainty score that combines predictive entropy with an Image-Information Score measuring the contribution of salient visual evidence to the prediction. Unlike entropy alone, which can be strongly influenced by language priors, VAUQ accounts for whether model confidence is supported by relevant image regions, making it well suited for visually grounded driving VQA. We further assess calibration using ECE and the Brier score. ECE measures the gap between predicted confidence and empirical accuracy, while the Brier score evaluates the overall quality of probabilistic predictions by penalizing both overconfident errors and poorly calibrated confidence estimates, with lower values indicating better calibration.
blocks.zh: 我们使用精确度、AUROC、预期校准误差(ECE)和Brier分数来评价模型性能。 精确度测量任务性能,而AUROC则评价不确定性与不正确的预测的区别程度. 对AUROC来说,我们使用VAUQ(Vision-Aware Un确定性量化)[40],这是无训练的不确定性分数,它结合了预测式 en和图像-信息分数,测量显著视觉证据对预测的贡献. 与仅Entropy可强受语言前传影响不同,VAUQ说明模型置信是否得到相关图像区域的支持,使其非常适合视觉基于驱动的VQA. 我们还利用欧洲经委会和布赖尔分数评估校准情况。 欧洲经委会衡量预测信心与实证准确性之间的差距,而布赖尔得分则通过惩罚过度自信错误和校准不足的自信估计,评价概率预测的总体质量,而较低的数值表明校准较好。

blocks.en: 3.3 Visual Corruptions
blocks.zh: 3.3 视觉腐败

blocks.en: For each dataset, we generate four corrupted variants of every clean image, glare , fog , motion blur , and lens occlusion , covering common illumination, weather, motion, and occlusion degradations. Following the Unstructured Scene Benchmark (USB) [ 30 ] , corruptions are applied independently using a fixed random seed, with severity parameters sampled per image from predefined ranges.
blocks.zh: 对于每个数据集,我们产生四个腐烂的变体 每一个干净的图像, 光亮,雾,运动模糊, 和镜头遮蔽, 覆盖常见的照明,天气,运动, 和遮蔽退化。 遵循无结构场景基准(USB)[30],使用固定随机种子独立运用腐败,每幅图像从预定义范围抽取严重程度参数.

blocks.en: 4 Results
blocks.zh: 4 结果

blocks.en: In this section, we first examine how visual corruptions affect model performance and confidence, and then evaluate whether V ​ EA \mathrm{V}{\scriptstyle\mathrm{EA}} improves model performance while maintaining reliable confidence under degraded visual inputs.
blocks.zh: 在本节中,我们首先审查视觉腐败如何影响模型性能和信心,然后评价V EA是否 \ mathrm{ V&scriptysty\ mathrm{ EA} 改进模型性能, 同时在退化的视觉输入下保持可靠的信任 。

blocks.en: 4.1 Robustness Analysis
blocks.zh: 4.1 强性分析

blocks.en: We first analyze model robustness under the four representative corruption conditions using accuracy, AUROC VAUQ , ECE, and Brier score, with each corrupted compared against the corresponding clean input. Table 1 reports the results on DrivingVQA, and Table 2 reports the results on NuScenes-QA-mini. Results on STRIDE-QA Bench and Open Spatial Reasoning (OSR) are given in the appendix in Tables 4 and 5 .
blocks.zh: 我们首先用准确度分析四个具有代表性的腐败条件下的模型稳健性,AUROC VAUQ,ECE,和Brier得分,每个都比对相应的干净输入. 表1报告了驾驶VQA的结果,表2报告了NuScens-QA-mini的结果。 关于STRIDE-QA座席和开放空间理由(OSR)的结果载于表4和表5附录。

blocks.en: On DrivingVQA, where questions combine driving scenes with driving knowledge, accuracy changes only slightly for most of the models. However, the confidence metrics show a different picture here. DriveFusionQA-4B stays close to chance AUROC VAUQ even though it has relatively low ECE and Brier scores, suggesting that its confidence may be reasonable on average but is not very useful for separating correct from incorrect predictions. Qwen3.5-9B, Gemma4-E4B, and Alpamayo-1.5-10B show more above-chance discrimination in several settings, although this does not always match their accuracy or calibration. Gemma4-E4B is a clear example where its accuracy changes only moderately under some corruptions, while AUROC VAUQ drops much more.
blocks.zh: 在驾驶VQA上,问题将驾驶场景与驾驶知识相结合,对于大多数型号来说,准确性仅略有变化. 然而,信心指标表明,这里的情况有所不同。 DriveFusionQA-4B虽然欧经委和布赖尔的得分相对较低,但仍保持接近机会,这表明其信心一般可能合理,但对于将正确预测与错误预测区分开来并不十分有用。 Quen3.5-9B,Gemma4-E4B,以及Alpamayo-1.5-10B在多个场合表现出更多的超强歧视,尽管这并不总是符合它们的准确性或校准. Gemma4-E4B是一个明显的例子,它的准确性在某些腐败下仅略有变化,而AUROC VAUQ的下降要大得多.

blocks.en: Table 1: DrivingVQA results under clean and corrupted conditions. We report Accuracy, AUROC VAUQ , ECE, and Brier score. Green and red show improvement and degradation relative to clean performance.
blocks.zh: 表1:在清洁和腐败的条件下驾驶VQA的结果。 我们报告准确性、AUROC VAUQ、ECE和Brier的得分。 绿色和红色显示出相对于清洁性能的改善和退化.

blocks.en: On NuScenes-QA-mini, which relies more on object-level, counting, directional, and relational reasoning, the effect of corruption is stronger. Qwen3.5-9B, Gemma4-E4B, and LLaVA-OV-7B retain above-chance AUROC VAUQ under several corruptions, suggesting that some visual information is still being used, although the drop from the clean setting shows that this signal becomes less reliable. DriveFusionQA-4B shows a different pattern. Its accuracy is slightly higher under the corrupted conditions and its ECE decreases, while AUROC VAUQ consistently drops. This suggests that the small gain in task accuracy does not reflect better visually grounded reliability.
blocks.zh: 在NuScens-QA-mini上,它更依赖于对象级,计数,方向,关系推理,腐败的影响更强. Quen3.5-9B,Gemma4-E4B,和LLaVA-OV-7B在多个腐败下保留了上-chance AUROC VAUQ,暗示一些视觉信息仍在使用中,虽然从清洁设置的下降表明这个信号变得不那么可靠. DriveFusionQA-4B显示不同的模式. 在腐败的条件下,其准确度略高,欧洲经委会则下降,而AUROC VAUQ则持续下降。 这表明,任务准确度的微小收益没有更好地反映视觉上的可靠性。

blocks.en: Table 2: NuScenes-QA-mini results under clean and corrupted conditions. We report Accuracy, AUROC VAUQ , ECE, and Brier score. Green and red show improvement and degradation relative to clean performance.
blocks.zh: 表2:在清洁和腐败的条件下,NuScens-QA-mini结果。 我们报告准确性、AUROC VAUQ、ECE和Brier的得分。 绿色和红色显示出相对于清洁性能的改善和退化.

blocks.en: Compared with [ 29 ] and [ 30 ] , which show that VLMs can still give plausible answers when the visual input is degraded, our results suggest that models can still make some use of the corrupted visual input. However, their confidence does not always reflect when this visual evidence leads to a correct prediction. AUROC VAUQ can decrease even when accuracy changes only slightly, showing that stable task performance does not necessarily mean reliable visually grounded reasoning. We also find that no model performs consistently well across accuracy, calibration, and AUROC VAUQ . Some models are better calibrated but have weak discrimination between correct and incorrect predictions, while others show stronger discrimination but poor calibration. These results point to a reliability gap in current VLMs for driving tasks, where stable task performance does not always mean that the model can reliably judge whether its answer is supported by the visual input.
blocks.zh: 与[29]和[30]相比,这些显示VLM在视觉输入退化时仍然可以给出可信的答案,我们的结果表明模型仍然可以在一定程度上利用腐烂的视觉输入. 然而,当这种视觉证据导致正确的预测时,他们的信心并不总是反映的. AUROC VAUQ即使准确性仅稍有变化,也会下降,表明稳定的任务性能并不一定意味着可靠的视觉根据推理. 我们还发现,没有一种模型在准确度、校准度和AUROC VAUQ之间一贯表现良好。 一些模型的校准较好,但在正确的预测和不正确的预测之间差别不大,而另一些模型则显示出更强烈的歧视,但校准差。 这些结果显示当前驱动任务的VLM存在可靠性差距,稳定的任务性能并不总是意味着模型能够可靠地判断其答案是否得到视觉输入的支持.

blocks.en: 4.2 Visual Evidence Enhancement
blocks.zh: 4.2 增强视觉证据

blocks.en: Table 3 summarizes the effect of V ​ EA \mathrm{V}{\scriptstyle\mathrm{EA}} on accuracy across all four datasets. We use these results to examine whether V ​ EA \mathrm{V}{\scriptstyle\mathrm{EA}} helps on clean inputs and whether any gains remain under visual corruptions. Overall, its effect depends on the model and task. In some models, improvements on clean inputs are maintained under perturbations, as with Qwen3.5-9B on DrivingVQA and STRIDE-QA Bench and Alpamayo-1.5-10B on DrivingVQA and NuScenes-QA-mini. When V ​ EA \mathrm{V}{\scriptstyle\mathrm{EA}} is not helpful on clean inputs, the same limitation often remains under corruption, as seen for LLaVA-OV-7B on NuScenes-QA-mini and Alpamayo-1.5-10B on STRIDE-QA Bench. This suggests that V ​ EA \mathrm{V}{\scriptstyle\mathrm{EA}} can remain effective under degraded visual inputs, but not consistently across all model and dataset combinations.
blocks.zh: 表3总结了V EA\mathrm{V&presstyle\mathrm{EA}对所有四个数据集的准确性的影响. 我们利用这些结果来检查V EA\ mathrm{V\scripttyle\ mathrm{EA}是否有助于清洁输入,以及视觉腐败是否仍然存在任何收益。 总体而言,其效果取决于模式和任务. 在一些模式中,清洁投入的改进在扰动下得以维持,例如驾驶VQA和STRIDE-QA座椅的Quen3.5-9B和驾驶VQA和NuScenses-QA-mini的Alpamayo-15-10B。 当V EA\mathrm{V&scripttyle\mathrm{EA}对清洁输入没有帮助时,同样的限制往往仍然在腐败中,如NuScenes-QA-mini上的LLaVA-OV-7B和STRIDE-QA座上的Alpamayo-1.5-10B. 这表明V EA\mathrm{V&scriptystyle\mathrm{EA}在退化的视觉输入下可以保持有效,但不能在所有模型和数据集组合中保持一致.

blocks.en: STRIDE-QA Bench also shows an important limitation. V ​ EA \mathrm{V}{\scriptstyle\mathrm{EA}} re-weights spatial evidence but does not add temporal motion information, so it cannot directly address reasoning that depends strongly on temporal cues. This explains why Alpamayo-1.5-10B, despite benefiting strongly on DrivingVQA and NuScenes-QA-mini and mostly improving on OSR, consistently loses accuracy on STRIDE-QA Bench.
blocks.zh: 战略-QA 法官席位也显示出重要的限制。 V EA\ mathrm{V&scripttyle\ mathrm{EA} 重新对空间证据进行加权,但不添加时间运动信息,因此无法直接处理强烈依赖时间提示的推理. 这解释了为什么阿尔帕马约-1.5-10B尽管对驾驶VQA和NuScenes-QA-mini大有裨益,而且大多对操作SR大有改进,但STRIDE-QA法官组却始终失去准确性。

and degradation, respectively.
blocks.zh:
表3:应用V EA后准确性的变化 \ mathrm{ Vxystyle\ mathrm{ EA} 跨越所有四个数据集 。 绿色和红色显示改善

blocks.en: We then examine whether these performance gains are accompanied by more reliable confidence estimates. Figure 2 compares accuracy, AUROC VAUQ , ECE, and Brier before and after V ​ EA \mathrm{V}{\scriptstyle\mathrm{EA}} on DrivingVQA. The results show that higher accuracy does not always come with more reliable confidence. Qwen3.5-9B and Gemma4-E4B generally improve in accuracy and calibration, although their AUROC VAUQ changes are mixed. DriveFusionQA-4B gains little in accuracy, but its AUROC VAUQ and calibration metrics generally improve, suggesting that V ​ EA \mathrm{V}{\scriptstyle\mathrm{EA}} provides a larger benefit to reliability than to task performance. In contrast, Alpamayo-1.5-10B shows large and consistent accuracy gains while AUROC VAUQ , ECE, and Brier worsen, showing that better task performance does not necessarily mean that confidence becomes more reliable. LLaVA-OV-7B also shows a trade-off between correctness discrimination and calibration.
blocks.zh: 然后,我们审查这些绩效提高是否伴随着更可靠的信心估计。 图2比较了准确性、AUROC VAUQ、ECE和Brier在V EA\mathrm{V&scriptystyle\mathrm{EA}驾驶VQA前后的准确性。 结果显示,更高的准确性并不总是能带来更可靠的信心。 Quen3.5-9B和Gemma4-E4B在精度和校准方面普遍提高,尽管它们的AUROC VAUQ变化是混合的. DriverFusionQA-4B在准确性方面收益甚微,但其AUROC VAUQ和校准度量度普遍改善,说明V EA \ mathrm{ V\scripttyle\ mathrm{ EA} 对可靠性的好处大于任务性能的好处 。 与此相反,阿尔帕马约-1.5-10B显示,在欧统局、欧洲经委会和布赖尔的精确度提高的同时,也取得了巨大和一致的提高,这表明更好的任务业绩并不一定意味着信心变得更加可靠。 LLaVA-OV-7B也显示了正确性歧视和校准之间的权衡.

blocks.en: Overall, V ​ EA \mathrm{V}{\scriptstyle\mathrm{EA}} can improve performance and remains useful even under corruption for some models. But these gains are not always accompanied by more reliable confidence. The corresponding results for NuScenes-QA-mini Figure 3 , STRIDE-QA Bench Figure 5 , and OSR Figure 4 are provided in the appendix.
blocks.zh: 总体而言,V EA\mathrm{V\scriptystyle\mathrm{EA}可以提高性能,即使在腐败下对某些模型仍然有用. 但是,这些成果并不总是伴随着更可靠的信任。 附录提供了NuScens-QA-mini图3、STRIDE-QA座椅图5和OSR图4的相应结果。

blocks.en: Figure 2: Effect of VEA on Accuracy, AUROC VAUQ , ECE, and Brier score on DrivingVQA under clean and corrupted conditions.
blocks.zh: 图2:VEA对准确性的影响,AUROC VAUQ、欧洲经委会和Brier在清洁和腐败条件下驾驶VQA的得分。

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: In this work, we evaluated general purpose and driving specialized VLMs under clean and corrupted visual conditions using accuracy and confidence. We found that model performance and confidence reliability do not always change in the same way, and no model performs consistently well across accuracy, calibration, and AUROC. We also evaluated V ​ EA \mathrm{V}{\scriptstyle\mathrm{EA}} as an inference time method and found that it improves performance for some model and dataset combinations, with many of these gains remaining under corruption. However, its effect is task and model dependent, and improved accuracy does not always come with more reliable confidence.
blocks.zh: 在这项工作中,我们评价了一般目的,并利用准确性和信心,在清洁和腐败的视觉条件下驾驶专门的甚高频。 我们发现模型的性能和可靠性并不总是以同样的方式变化,没有一个模型在准确度、校准度和AUROC之间一贯表现良好。 我们还评价了V EA\mathrm{V&scriptystyle\mathrm{EA}作为一种推论时间方法,并发现它改善了一些模型和数据集组合的性能,其中许多收益仍然处于腐败之中. 然而,它的作用取决于任务和模型,提高准确性并不总是能带来更可靠的信心。

blocks.en: Appendix A Supplementary Results
blocks.zh: 附录A 结果

blocks.en: For STRIDE-QA Bench, Table 4 shows the lowest overall accuracy among the four datasets, which reflects the difficulty of its spatiotemporal reasoning setting. Under corruption, the changes are mixed and should not be interpreted as clear gains or losses from a single metric. Qwen3.5-9B and DriveFusionQA-4B often show lower AUROC VAUQ , while Gemma4-E4B and Alpamayo-1.5-10B sometimes show better ECE or Brier despite limited or lower accuracy. LLaVA-OV-7B remains below chance in AUROC VAUQ across all conditions, suggesting that its confidence is not reliably aligned with visually grounded correctness in this setting.
blocks.zh: 对于STRIDE-QA法官,表4显示四个数据集中总体准确度最低,这反映了其瞬间推理设置的困难。 在腐败下,变化喜忧参半,不应被解释为单一衡量标准产生的明显收益或损失。 Quen3.5-9B和DriveFusionQA-4B经常显示较低的AUROC VAUQ,而Gemma4-E4B和Alpamayo-1.5-10B尽管精度有限或较低,但有时显示较好的ECE或Brier. LLaVA-OV-7B在AUROC VAUQ中,在所有情况下都仍然低于机会,这表明其信心在这一背景下不可靠地与视网膜上的正确性一致。

blocks.en: For OSR, Table 5 also shows strong disagreement between accuracy, AUROC VAUQ , and calibration under corruption. Some conditions produce higher accuracy or lower calibration error, while AUROC VAUQ moves in the opposite direction, showing that these changes do not necessarily reflect more reliable reasoning. Since OSR contains only 50 samples, the condition level differences are particularly noisy and are best treated as supporting evidence rather than firm conclusions.
blocks.zh: 就业务标准而言,表5还显示准确性、AUROC VAUQ和腐败下的校准之间存在很大分歧。 一些条件产生更高的准确性或较低的校准错误,而AUROC VAUQ则向相反的方向移动,表明这些变化并不一定反映更可靠的推理. 由于OSR只包含50个样本,因此条件水平差异特别吵闹,最好作为佐证而不是确定的结论处理。

blocks.en: Across NuScenes-QA-mini Figure 3 , STRIDE-QA Bench Figure 5 , and OSR Figure 4 , V ​ EA \mathrm{V}{\scriptstyle\mathrm{EA}} does not produce a uniform change in reliability. Its effect depends on the model and task, and gains in accuracy or calibration are not always matched by better AUROC VAUQ . This supports the same overall finding that V ​ EA \mathrm{V}{\scriptstyle\mathrm{EA}} should be assessed across both performance and confidence reliability rather than using a single metric.
blocks.zh: 在整个 NuScens-QA-mini 图3, STRIDE-QA 座椅图5, 和 OSR 图4, V EA\mathrm{V&scriptyle\mathrm{EA} 并不产生统一的可靠性变化. 它的效果取决于模型和任务,准确度或校准率的提高并不总是与更好的AUROC VAUQ相匹配. 这支持同样的总体结论,即V EA\mathrm{V\scripttyle\mathrm{EA}应该在性能和信心可靠性两方面进行评估,而不是使用单一的度量.

blocks.en: Appendix B V ​ EA \mathrm{V}{\scriptstyle\mathrm{EA}} Computation Time
blocks.zh: 附录B V EA\ mathrm{V\scripttyle\ mathrm{EA} 计算时间

blocks.en: We also measure the additional evidence extraction time introduced by V ​ EA \mathrm{V}{\scriptstyle\mathrm{EA}} , as shown in Figure 6 . For DrivingVQA, NuScenes-QA-mini, and OSR, the added time is generally below one second across models. The overhead is higher on STRIDE-QA Bench, reaching about 1.3 seconds for Qwen3.5-9B and 3 seconds for DriveFusionQA-4B. This shows that V ​ EA \mathrm{V}{\scriptstyle\mathrm{EA}} can add only a small cost in many settings, but the cost is not consistent across models and tasks. For real time deployment, this additional latency is important because V ​ EA \mathrm{V}{\scriptstyle\mathrm{EA}} is added on top of the original model inference time. Therefore, while the current results show that V ​ EA \mathrm{V}{\scriptstyle\mathrm{EA}} can improve performance and reliability in several settings, reducing its computation cost would also be necessary for applications with strict real time requirements.
blocks.zh: 我们还测量了V EA\mathrm{V&scripttyle\mathrm{EA}引入的额外证据提取时间,如图6所示。 对于驾驶VQA,NuScenes-QA-mini,以及OSR,各型号增加的时间一般低于一秒. 在STRIDE-QA座椅上,管理费较高,在Quen3.5-9B和DriveFusionQA-4B上分别达到约1.3秒和3秒. 这表明V EA\mathrm{V\scripttyle\mathrm{EA}在许多设置中只能增加少量成本,但成本在模型和任务之间并不一致. 对于实时部署,这个额外的延迟很重要,因为V EA\mathrm{V&scriptysty\mathrm{EA}被添加到原始模型推断时间之上. 因此,尽管目前的结果表明,V EA \ mathrm{ V\scriptysty\ mathrm{ EA} 可以提高几个环境中的性能和可靠性, 降低其计算成本对于有严格实时要求的应用程序也是必要的 。
